name: Diphilus
bio: Diphilus is one of the named epigrammatists whose short poems are preserved in the Greek Anthology. Paton's Index of Authors dates the poet to the 4th century BC. Paton's index calls him the comic poet.
This archive carries the 1 epigram ascribed to the poet in the fourth volume of W. R. Paton's prose translation (Loeb, 1918): Book XI: 439.

poems.title: Book XI, 439
poems.author: Diphilus
poems.text: Argos is the land of horses, but the inhabitants are wolves.
